Tests two-column layout pairing a line chart with interpretive narrative text
Tests two-column layout with bar chart and tabular data that must be internally consistent
Tests Flow/FlowNode/FlowConnection nodes for a data processing pipeline with decision branching
Complexity ceiling case: exercises full node vocabulary, FORBIDDEN blocklist under load, KPI + chart + table + bullets competing for vertical budget. If layout breaks, it breaks here first.
Hardest case: KPI row (Phase A) + Table (Phase C) + Chart (Phase B) on one slide. Stress test of layout density and FORBIDDEN blocklist under load.

Tests all Phase D inline formatting tags (A, U, S, Sub, Sup) in Text, Li, and Td contexts
Table/Col/Tr/Td are Phase C nodes. Knowledge base + allowlist added in Phase 6.

Test suite spans from minimal-statement (floor: single text node) to maximal-density (ceiling: full node vocabulary). Boundary cases catch regressions in contract scope and layout overflow.
